meta.title: 3个设置，让你的剪辑效率翻倍！
meta.title_en: 3 Settings That Double Your Editing Speed!
meta.topic: 视频剪辑 · 效率提升

scenes.title_en: The Three Stages of a New Editor
scenes.context: 新手剪辑通常经历三个阶段：一、手机剪一切，找功能在工具栏翻半天；二、电脑剪，但鼠标操作一切，切一刀和小垃圾桶成了好伙伴；三、会用高频快捷键。语域：剪辑教学，阶段引入。
sentences: 新手剪辑，通常经历三个阶段。
New editors usually go through three stages.
go through three stages（经历三个阶段）
手机剪一切，找功能翻半天。
Editing on your phone means hunting for every tool.
hunting for tools（找功能）
第三阶段：会用高频快捷键。
Stage three: mastering the high-use shortcuts.
high-use shortcuts（高频快捷键）
paraphrase: 剪一切 → edit everything / do it all on phone
scenes.speak: New editors usually go through three stages. Editing on your phone means hunting for every tool. Stage three: mastering the high-use shortcuts.

scenes.context: 快捷键：Command+K剪一刀，退格键删除，左右键逐帧浏览，上下键片段间切换。使用快捷键让剪辑效率翻倍，完全不夸张。语域：剪辑教学，快捷键讲解。
sentences: Command+K 剪一刀。
Command+K cuts a clip.
cuts a clip（剪一刀）
退格键删除，左右键逐帧浏览。
Backspace deletes; arrow keys scrub frame by frame.
scrub frame by frame（逐帧浏览）
快捷键，让效率翻倍。
Shortcuts double your editing speed.
double your speed（效率翻倍）
paraphrase: 剪一刀 → cut a clip / make a cut
cut a clip · make a cut
逐帧浏览 → frame by frame / scrub the timeline
frame by frame · scrub the timeline
scenes.speak: Command+K cuts a clip. Backspace deletes; arrow keys scrub frame by frame. Shortcuts double your editing speed.

scenes.context: 右上角不起眼的角落有一个快捷键设置，可以看到所有功能对应的键位，并且全都可以按需修改。语域：剪辑教学，设置讲解。
sentences: 右上角角落，有快捷键设置。
In the corner, there's the shortcut settings.
the shortcut settings（快捷键设置）
所有功能的键位都能看到。
Every function's key binding is visible.
key binding（键位）
全都可以按需修改。
And all of them are customizable.
customizable（可修改）
paraphrase: 快捷键设置 → shortcut settings / key config
键位 → key binding / assigned keys
scenes.speak: In the corner, there's the shortcut settings. Every function's key binding is visible. And all of them are customizable.

scenes.title_en: Pro Key Layout: Cut, Trim, Delete
scenes.context: 分享一套用了7年、剪了上千条视频不断优化出来的高效键位：大师技能键位。第一步，剪切删的设置：把左手自然放在键盘上。语域：剪辑教学，设置分享。
sentences: 这套键位，用了7年不断优化。
This key layout was refined over seven years.
refined over seven years（7年优化）
第一步：剪切删的设置。
Step one: set up cut, trim, and delete.
cut, trim, and delete（剪切删）
左手自然放在键盘上。
Rest your left hand naturally on the keyboard.
rest your left hand（左手放松）
paraphrase: 大师级键位 → pro key layout / master shortcuts
剪切删 → cut, trim, delete / the editing core
scenes.speak: This key layout was refined over seven years. Step one: set up cut, trim, and delete. Rest your left hand naturally on the keyboard.

practice: New editors usually go through three stages.
Every function's key binding is visible.
This key layout was refined over seven years.
pitfalls: Look for functions for a long time.
Editing on your phone means hunting for every tool.
Backspace deletes; arrow keys scrub frame by frame.
「逐帧浏览」用 scrub frame by frame。
shifts: 用 cut a clip（剪一刀）、scrub frame by frame（逐帧浏览）、trim（修剪）
用 double your speed（效率翻倍）、high-use shortcuts（高频快捷键）、customizable（可自定义）
用 key binding（键位）、key config（键位配置）、pro key layout（大师键位）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正（繁体）：收機→手机、剪一切、細細→细细、軌道→轨道、括號→括号、卡帽→Command、退隔→退格、逐陣→逐帧、鍵機→键位、剪切删、大師技能→大师技能、上千條→上千条等。
